partially_covered.missing: Still lacks explicit properties for organization details beyond address and identifier (e.g., contact info, registration number).
No explicit grouping or linking class/property for holistic invoice details; details remain fragmented across classes.

cq_coverage.details: Most CQs are well supported, especially those concerning invoice structure, roles, and line items. CQ5 and CQ10 remain only partially addressed due to missing organization detail properties and lack of an invoice detail aggregator.

issues: Pivot class :InvoiceLineItemDetail is still subclassed by :LineItem, which violates best practice (pivot classes should not be subclassed by their components).

strengths: Deep and well-labeled hierarchy closely reflecting EDIFACT and P2P-O structure
Good use of equivalence and some restrictions
Disjointness between key role and address classes
weaknesses: No GCAs for complex role assignments or process linkage
No property characteristics (e.g., functional, inverse functional) defined

likely_oops_pitfalls: P7: Inappropriate subclassing of pivot classes
P4: Missing property characteristics (optional, but best practice)
reasoner_risks: Hermit/Pellet may flag subclassing of pivot classes as a modeling error
Complex restrictions may slow reasoning but are not fatal
